import sys
from collections import defaultdict
def main():
    d = defaultdict(float)
    it = iter(sys.stdin.buffer)
    next(it)
    for line in it:
        p = line.rstrip(b"\r\n").split(b",")
        d[p[1]] += float(p[2])
    out = [f"{k.decode()},{v:.2f}" for k, v in sorted(d.items())]
    print("\n".join(out))
main()
